# 2026-03-14

## Conversation with the team

We discussed calling the indexer straight from the writer instead of going
through a queue. The queue absorbs write spikes and keeps indexing off the
critical path of the write; the cost is eventual consistency. For a single-user
CLI there are no concurrent writers, so we chose the direct call. Notes in
[[architecture]].
